stepTitle: Space probes may be separated from their launchers by exploding bolts. (They bolt away from one another.) Suppose a $$4800\, \text{kg}$$ satellite uses this method to separate from the $$1500\, \text{kg}$$ remains of its launcher, and that $$5000\, \text{J}$$ of kinetic energy is supplied to the two parts. What are their subsequent velocities using the frame of reference in which they were at rest before separation?
